schema.description: Creates a new generic pipe definition in the given or default project.

export.description: When true, the declaring NgModule exports this pipe.

flat.description: When true (the default) creates files at the top level of the project.

lintFix.description: When true, applies lint fixes after generating the pipe.

name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the pipe?

path.description: The path at which to create the pipe, relative to the workspace root.

skipImport.description: When true, does not import this pipe into the owning NgModule.

skipTests.description: When true, does not create "spec.ts" test files for the new pipe.

spec.description: When true (the default), generates a  "spec.ts" test file for the new pipe.

schema.title: Angular Pipe Options Schema

description:
Hi team,

We're set to add a new pipe named **truncate** to the **my-angular-app** project. The pipe will be created under the **src/app/pipes** directory (so it won’t be flattened at the top level) and will be declared in the **shared/pipes** NgModule. We’ve decided to export the pipe from that module, and we’ll also have it automatically imported into the owning NgModule. After generation, lint fixes will be applied to keep the code clean. Additionally, a corresponding **spec.ts** test file will be generated (the “spec” option is enabled), and we’re not skipping tests.

All standard options are left at their defaults except for the ones we’ve explicitly set: export = true, flat = false, lintFix = true, skipImport = false, and skipTests = false. This configuration should give us a fully functional, test‑covered pipe ready for use across the application.
